entries.title: Skin checker
entries.text: Scores a skin or design package out of 100 and lists what breaks a professional look: spacing off the token scale, more than two typefaces or off-scale type sizes, palette sprawl and near-duplicate colours, contrast below WCAG AA, and inconsistent radius, borders and shadows. Most issues have a one-click fix.

entries.title: Skin editor settings
entries.text: The checker's thresholds (minimum score, typefaces, palette size, contrast ratios, radii, border widths, shadows) and each rule's severity, plus install & uninstall.

entries.title: Fix all
entries.text: Applies every fix the checker offers for this skin. Fixed assets are saved as copies in the plugin's data folder; the built-in asset files are not changed.

entries.title: Check again
entries.text: Runs the checker again with the current settings and assets.

entries.title: Token
entries.text: The value an issue points at. Edit it here and the check runs again when you stop typing.
